title: Rav Huna, Father of Rabbi Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bamidbar Rabbah 9:12: his students asked Rav Huna, the father of Rabbi Acha, “You taught us, our master, that the adulterer and the adulteress transgress the Ten Commandments.” So it is in Tanchuma, Naso. But Tanchuma Buber reads Rabbi Chanina, the father of Rabbi Acha, and so it is in the Yalkut, Naso, remez 704.

notes.text: The expression says “you taught us,” a report of prior teaching, rather than requesting “teach us.” The connected saved witness supports that grammatical direction.
The consulted Bamidbar Rabbah names Rav Huna. The consulted Buber Tanchuma names Chanina as the father of Acha.
